# Seccomp deny-list parity: x86_64 / aarch64 / armv7

Security plan S4.3. The only seccomp deny-list in the repository is omnode's
(`edge/openmind-node/src/seccomp.rs`, default ALLOW, listed syscalls return EPERM,
foreign ABI killed). `crates/openmind-sandbox` has no seccomp filter by design
(userns + Landlock + rlimits + caps); the raw syscall numbers it calls itself
are listed at the bottom of the table and checked against its source.

Rule (unit test `seccomp_table::tests::parity_holds`, run by CI in the omnode job):
a syscall denied on one architecture must be denied on every other one, unless an
exception below says why (normally: the syscall does not exist there).

Numbers: x86_64 `arch/x86/entry/syscalls/syscall_64.tbl`, aarch64 `scripts/syscall.tbl`
(asm-generic), armv7 `arch/arm/tools/syscall.tbl` (Linux master, read 2026-10-21 +02:00).
`-` = no such syscall on that arch.

## Totals

| arch | denied numbers (own + unified) |
|---|---|
| x86_64 | 40 (27 + 13) |
| aarch64 | 38 (25 + 13) |
| armv7 | 39 (26 + 13) |

## Written exceptions (denied elsewhere, not here)

| syscall | arch | reason |
|---|---|---|
| `iopl` | aarch64 | x86-only syscall; not in the arm64/arm tables |
| `iopl` | armv7 | x86-only syscall; not in the arm64/arm tables |
| `ioperm` | aarch64 | x86-only syscall; not in the arm64/arm tables |
| `ioperm` | armv7 | x86-only syscall; not in the arm64/arm tables |
| `umount` | x86_64 | 32-bit ARM OABI-only call; no such syscall on this arch |
| `umount` | aarch64 | 32-bit ARM OABI-only call; no such syscall on this arch |

## Deliberately allowed on every arch

| syscall | why |
|---|---|
| `setns` | needs a namespace fd and CAP_SYS_ADMIN over its owner; the child has none after unshare is denied |
| `chroot` | needs CAP_SYS_CHROOT; harmless without it; some tools probe it |
| `kcmp` | ptrace-access check on both pids; ptrace itself is denied |
| `syslog` | kernel.dmesg_restrict governs it; denying breaks nothing but is not needed for escape |
| `uselib` | legacy a.out loader, usually compiled out (CONFIG_USELIB); same on both arches that have it |
| `modify_ldt` | x86 only; candidate for D-220-3 (deny on x86_64) |
| `_sysctl` | removed in Linux 5.5 (ENOSYS) |
| `process_madvise` | needs ptrace-access (PTRACE_MODE_READ) plus CAP_SYS_NICE over the target |
| `close_range` | openmind-sandbox closes inherited fds with it; must stay allowed |
| `landlock_create_ruleset` | self-restriction only; omnode's own sandbox uses Landlock |
| `landlock_add_rule` | self-restriction only |
| `landlock_restrict_self` | self-restriction only |

## Parity result

PASS: 0 violations.

## Not covered by the number table

- x86_64 x32 (nr | 0x40000000) and i386 calls: the filter kills any nr >= 0x40000000
  and any arch other than the build arch, so those tables need no rows.
- 32-bit ARM private calls (0x0f0000+, e.g. `cacheflush`, `set_tls`) are allowed;
  none of them changes the host or reaches another process.
- Enforcement on real aarch64/armv7 kernels is a separate test (sandbox runs only on
  the VPS; see plans/security.md). This table proves the lists agree, not that a
  given kernel loads them.
